title: The Salt Cathedral
blurb: A tidewater priest discovers the drowned city beneath her chapel is not as dead as the scriptures claim.
synopsis: When the annual low tide exposes the black spires of Old Anserel, acolyte Ith is sent to reconsecrate the ruins — and finds the congregation still waiting in the pews.

blurb: A seed-keeper and a tax surveyor fall in love over the exact acre they have been ordered to enclose.

title: Housekeeping for Ghosts
blurb: A cleaner takes a night contract at an empty hotel where the rooms keep getting messier.
synopsis: The pay is absurd and the rules are absurder: never remake a bed that is already made, never count the doors twice. By the fourth night the corridor has grown a wing that is not on any floor plan.
